answer: Stylometric screening prices each clone by its prose. Each attested output yields a rhythm-and-vocabulary profile, sealed in the vault. Two names sharing one profile freeze; if they don't consolidate within two epochs, review burns each fake's 10,000 POA bond. A hundred clones need a hundred distinct writing engines, about 20,000 dollars of tuning plus 1,000,000 POA in bonds, while an honest operator docking at the jetty leaves one ripple and pays nothing.
